done_when: An accepted decision records the owner's choice, pyproject.toml's line_ceiling is 7500, the tests that pin the ceiling follow it, and the full suite passes

findings.body: The new accepted decision sets the cap to 7,500, but the confirmed v1 spec still says 7,000 at docs/specs/lean-forge-v1.md:30, 593–594, and 646–647. Its acceptance criterion therefore conflicts with the configured limit and could lead a reviewer to reject Python growth that this decision permits. Update those references to 7,500 and decision 0096.
findings.title: Update the confirmed v1 spec's 7,000-line rule

why: Forge's Python is at 6,915 of its 7,000 cap and five approved tasks still add code; the owner raised the cap to 7,500 on 2026-09-28
